title: SLE and atherosclerosis CD4+ T-cell RNAsequencing
description: Bulk RNAsequencing of CD4+ T-cells in SLE patients with (SLE-P) and without (SLE-NP) subclinical atherosclerotic plaques in carotid and femoral arteries, scanned by vascular ultrasound.

samples.title: Sample 1
samples.description: Protocols: Venipuncture. Patients were scanned for carotid and femoral atherosclerotic plaques by vascular ultrasound. Blood was collected and CD4+ T-cells were isolated for sequencing/ Qiagen PAXgene Blood storage to isolate PBMCs. CD4+ T-cells were isolated using FACSAria flow cytometry. RNA was isolated using Picpure RNA isolation kit. Sample concentrations and purity were determined using Agilent’s 2200 Tapestation Sequencing, quality control analysis, genome alignment and quantification was performed by UCL Genomics (London, UK)

runs.experiment_title: NextSeq 500 sequencing: SLE and atherosclerosis CD4+ T-cell RNAsequencing
